row.scim_plan: Contact Sales (via Adobe Admin Console Entra ID Sync)
row.evidence: Adobe's Workfront pricing page sells Select, Prime and Ultimate only through 'Get pricing' / 'Get customized Workfront pricing', and Workfront users are now managed in the Adobe Admin Console, whose Microsoft Entra ID Sync 'uses the SCIM protocol'.
row.notes: Quote-only: Select, Prime and Ultimate have no public prices. All Workfront organisations are now on the Adobe Admin Console (Adobe Business Platform). Users get Workfront by being added to the Workfront product profile there, and the legacy Workfront SAML 2.0 setup, including its auto-provisioning (JIT), is no longer available. There is no Workfront-specific SCIM endpoint. SCIM provisioning reaches Workfront only through Adobe Admin Console Microsoft Entra ID Sync, which needs a federated directory. Google is a separate Adobe-run Google Sync, and the User Sync Tool and User Management API are other options. So SCIM works with Entra only. The pricing table's 'Enterprise administration, security, and compliance' row (which includes single sign-on) shows 'some features' for Select and 'all features' for Prime and Ultimate (read from the icon alt text). The Workfront REST API (/attask/api) can search and deactivate users and has event subscriptions for USER objects.

auth.token_source: Adobe Admin Console > Settings > Directory Details > Sync > Add Sync > Sync users from Microsoft Azure (Tenant URL + Secret token)
auth.notes: This is Adobe Admin Console's SCIM, not a Workfront endpoint; it requires a federated (SSO) directory with verified domains.

operations.notes: From Microsoft's Adobe Identity Management (SAML) provisioning tutorial; users reach Workfront when their Admin Console group carries the Workfront product profile.

deprovision.data_retained: Entra removes the user from Adobe Identity Management; Workfront access ends when the user leaves the Admin Console user group or product profile. A Workfront-side deactivation keeps all data and frees the Workfront licence, but does not remove the Admin Console assignment.

attributes.notes: Microsoft's tutorial lists an Adobe extension (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:Adobe:2.0:User, e.g. emailAliases, eduRole); Workfront-specific attributes (access level, home group) are not set by SCIM.

roles.how: Product access via Admin Console user groups mapped to the Workfront product profile; Workfront access levels are set inside Workfront, and System Administrator only from the Admin Console.

limitations.text: SCIM is only available through Adobe Admin Console Microsoft Entra ID Sync; Google uses Adobe's own Google Sync and other IdPs need the User Sync Tool or User Management API.
Once Entra ID Sync is set up, users in that directory cannot be managed manually or with other sync methods.
Deactivating a user inside Workfront does not deactivate them in the Admin Console or remove their product-profile group membership.

auth.notes: OAuth2 (server JWT flow or user authorization-code flow) is recommended; the /login endpoint and API keys are no longer recommended.

capabilities.notes: Generic object CRUD (search/get/put/delete via method=) applies to USER objects; the deactivation guide documents USER search and the isActive update. Deleting users must happen in the Admin Console.

endpoints.purpose: List/search users (example from the deactivate-user guide)
Deactivate a user by setting isActive to false
Generate an API key for a user (no longer recommended)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Event subscriptions support objCode USER; event types are CREATE, DELETE and UPDATE.

rate_limits.text: Concurrent API threads are limited per environment (number not stated in the quoted text).

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/workfront/ and /adobe-workfront/ return 404; no Workfront OIN page found.

entra.notes: The Workfront gallery app is SSO-only (users are created manually). Provisioning instead goes through the separate 'Adobe Identity Management (SAML/OIDC)' gallery app into the Adobe Admin Console.

google.notes: Adobe Admin Console offers Google Sync (Adobe-run directory sync); the Google Workspace catalogue was not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Adobe Admin Console Google Sync, User Sync Tool and User Management API; automatic product assignment rules
fallbacks.notes: Legacy Workfront SAML 2.0 'Auto-Provision Users' (JIT) is no longer available now that every organisation is on the Admin Console.
